ties.basis: 025-1b-LE-006.krn lines 341/350: source tie continues in another encoded voice of the same staff; LilyPond cannot tie across voices, so the note is held, not reattacked.

bars.description: Bars 1-63 once in written order. The source has no repeat signs; nothing is cut or repeated.

endpoints.basis: MEAS, cached pitch features. First: the opening B4/D-sharp5 trill in thirds (MIDI 71/75) rises from -36.5 to -23 dB re the 95th-percentile total at 0.8-0.9 s (flux peak 0.84 s). A broad 0-4 s window had chosen a louder trill attack at 2.42 s and compressed bar 2; rejected. Last: the final G-sharp-major chord (q248, MIDI 44/51/56/60/63/72) has its flux peak at 123.60 s, after the quiet chords of bars 61-62 (D-sharp2 chord rise 120.68 s). A broad 110-129 s window had chosen 111.22 s inside the chromatic descent of bars 58-59 and collapsed 26 note durations; rejected.

Edition: the Paris edition of Études Op. 25 catalogued by NIFC Chopin First Editions Online as 025-1b-LE-006, publisher recorded in the file as Lemoine, Paris (RISM 1001002392, PL-Wbfc 4808/n); encoding Marta Lawrence, editing Wojciech Jakubiak-Danek and Mateusz Mrugas. The performer's edition is not established; first-edition readings can differ from later editions.

Conversion: tools/align/humdrum_convert.py reads the unchanged **kern tokens (Humdrum line timing, spine splits/merges, explicit sounding pitches, ties, graces, tuplets) and writes plain MusicXML for the pinned LilyPond 2.24.4 converter. Dynamics, hairpins, pedalling, fingering, stems, layout comments, *rscale display scaling, cue size and editorial text are not converted; slurs are kept only when both ends lie in one encoded voice. Voices are the encoded Humdrum sub-spines on each staff (MusicXML voices 1-4 upper, 5-8 lower), labelled here only as upper/lower staff.

Source identity (MEAS): the compiled events match all 2,550 regular **kern attacks (tied continuations excluded) by pitch within one MIDI tick (maximum onset difference 0.0 quarter), plus the single grace note. Independent check with Verovio 6.3.0's Humdrum importer: 2,553 notes in both readings; per-measure relative timing agrees in all 63 measures.
One source tie continues in a different encoded voice (F-sharp5 into bar 16, lines 341/350); extraction.ties holds it as one event. The engraving may show that tie arc as unterminated.

anchors.label: bar-30-last-A-sharp2
anchors.basis: MEAS: the last bar-30 attack A-sharp2/B4/D5 (q119.5, MIDI 46/71/74) precedes the breath before bar 31. A-sharp2 rises at 55.65-55.75 s (-44 to -28 dB re the 95th-percentile total) with B4/D5 jumping at 55.70-55.75 s; the preceding D5-sharp/F3 attack of q119 (75/53) rises at 55.40-55.55 s. With only the bar-31 constraints the map stretched q119-q119.5 into the breath (about 55.55-55.95 s).

anchors.label: bar-31-E2-chord
anchors.basis: MEAS: the bar-31 downbeat E2/C-sharp4/A-sharp4/C-sharp5 (q120). MEAS band energies (dB re the 95th-percentile total): E2 (MIDI 40) and its partials E3/B3 (52/59) rise at 56.20-56.35 s after a near-silent breath from 55.85 s; E5 (76) and E6 (88) jump at 56.90-56.95 s (-35 to -15 dB), C-sharp6/E6 (85/88 region) at 57.20 s. The unconstrained pass placed q120 at 56.02 s inside the breath and the bar-31 upper figures about 0.6 s before their measured rises.

anchors.label: bar-31-first-upper-thirds
anchors.basis: MEAS: the first bar-31 upper-register chord E5/G5/A-sharp6/C-sharp7 (q120.5, MIDI 76/79/94/97). MEAS band energies (dB re the 95th-percentile total): E2 (MIDI 40) and its partials E3/B3 (52/59) rise at 56.20-56.35 s after a near-silent breath from 55.85 s; E5 (76) and E6 (88) jump at 56.90-56.95 s (-35 to -15 dB), C-sharp6/E6 (85/88 region) at 57.20 s. The unconstrained pass placed q120 at 56.02 s inside the breath and the bar-31 upper figures about 0.6 s before their measured rises.

anchors.label: bar-34-G3-A-sharp3-C-sharp5-D-sharp5
anchors.basis: MEAS, cached pitch features (dB re the 95th-percentile total): the bar-34 sixteenth G3/A-sharp3/C-sharp5/D-sharp5 at q135.5 (MIDI 55/58/73/75), the last of that chord before q135.75. C-sharp5 rises from -40.3 dB at 64.42 s to -24.4 dB at 64.50 s and G3 from -56.5 to -44.2 dB; detector leading edge 64.44 s (peak 64.48 s); adaptive onset 64.482 s. Added because the run with the q135.75 and q136 constraints still placed q135.5 at 64.02 s, 0.42 s early, and stretched q135.5-q135.75 over 0.76 s; see the q135.75 basis for the measured ritardando (63.94/64.16/64.44/64.78 s).

anchors.label: bar-34-last-C4-D4-G4-A-sharp4
anchors.basis: MEAS, cached pitch features (dB re the 95th-percentile total): the last bar-34 sixteenth C4/D4/G4/A-sharp4 (q135.75, MIDI 60/62/67/70) before the reprise. C4 rises from -56.3 dB at 64.72 s to -43.1 dB at 64.82 s, D4 from -55.0 to -42.6 dB, G4 from -24.5 dB at 64.76 s to -16.3 dB at 64.88 s and A-sharp4 from -34.5 dB at 64.78 s to -21.6 dB at 64.86 s. Detector leading edge 64.78 s (peak 64.84 s); primary onset 64.842 s. The same detector on bar 34's second half gives q135 63.94, q135.25 64.16, q135.5 64.44 and q135.75 64.78 s: a ritardando into bar 35 at 65.16 s. Added because a dry run with only the q136 constraint placed q135.25-q135.75 at 64.61/64.92/65.05 s, 0.27-0.48 s late; the previous publication had them at 63.90/64.02/64.17 s.

anchors.label: bar-35-reprise-G-sharp2-B4-D-sharp5
anchors.basis: MEAS, cached pitch features (dB re the 95th-percentile total): the bar-35 reprise, the opening trill third B4/D-sharp5 over the G-sharp2 bass (q136, MIDI 44/71/75). G-sharp2 rises from -56.1 dB at 65.06 s to -42.3 dB at 65.18 s and -36.5 dB at 65.36 s; B4 from -47.5 dB at 65.06 s to -22.8 dB at 65.18 s. Bar 34's second-half G4/A-sharp4 bands stay high until 64.9-65.0 s. Detector leading edge 65.16 s (peak 65.20 s); primary onsets 64.842 and 65.213 s. The left-hand D-sharp3 then rises at about 65.65 s and B3 at 65.84 s. The previous publication lit bar 35 at 64.29 s, about 0.9 s early (independent review RevScoresChopin: G-sharp2 65.18 s, B4 65.19 s, flux onset 65.21 s).

anchors.label: bar-61-G-sharp-chord
anchors.basis: MEAS: the bar-61 downbeat G-sharp1/G-sharp2/C3/D-sharp3 (q240), the third repeated G-sharp2 bass after those at q238/q239. G-sharp2 (MIDI 44) band rises at 113.6-113.7, 114.15-114.2 and 114.85-114.9 s (-41.9 to -35.4 dB re the 95th-percentile total), then all bands decay to below -45 dB by 115.4 s. With only the later constraints the map moved q240 to 115.35 s, into that decay.

anchors.label: bar-61-C-sharp2-chord

The numerical pass without these constraints placed q242 at 116.2 s inside the silence, q244 at 117.17 s and q246 at 118.2 s.
